description: Arch Capital Group Ltd. is a publicly listed Bermuda exempted company and a member of the S&P 500 index that provides insurance, reinsurance and mortgage insurance on a worldwide basis through its wholly owned subsidiaries. While positioned to provide a full range of property, casualty and mortgage insurance and reinsurance lines, it focuses on writing specialty lines of insurance and reinsurance, and had approximately $26.9 billion in capital at December 31, 2025, writing $16.5 billion of net premiums and reporting net income available to Arch common shareholders of $4.4 billion in 2025, with book value per share of $65.11 at December 31, 2025 compared to $53.11 per share a year earlier.
